text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the Mile<n>Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the final moments before the race,<n>Taiki Shuttle
can only think about<n>running her heart out.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Determined to beat Silence Suzuka,<n>and—above
all—to become the next<n>Umamusume of the Year...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle heads for the racecourse<n>full of
energy, with power in her every<n>step!
